about: A small spec with one decision left open: what a report shows when no trip falls on or after the since date. It must be asked while slicing and never again.

spec.title: Reports the office can work with

planted.what: What a report shows when no trip falls on or after the since date: the spec doesn't say (only a total line, a message, or an error).
planted.answer: A report with no trips since the date shows only the total line, with 0 trips.
